models.notes: The live-verified probe baseline (M8.2C1 inference, P2 pyds metadata, P3 tracker, P3.5/P4 analytics + observations). Traffic-camera domain; known to misclassify people as cars in non-traffic scenes (P4-D live run). Detection quality is the known blocker for zone-observation quality.

models.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED probe (P5-B, 2026-06-11, crowdcountS2 RTX 5070 Ti): official raw ONNX (sha256 c5c2d13e59ae883e6af3b45daea64af4833a4951c92d116ec270d9ddbe998063) + Upstream custom grid-decode parser through the pyds metadata path on a live h264 1280x720@30 stream — person detected in 1300/1300 frames (conf ~0.93) where TrafficCamNet was unreliable. FP16 TensorRT engine (TRT 10.9) builds in ~222s and is cached in the host model store. Artifacts operator-prepared (scripts/prepare_yolox_model.sh), never committed. Tracker/analytics with YOLOX not yet verified; compute/pricing values remain placeholders.
